headline: LAX shows the clearest cross-brand contrast.
evidence_text: At LAX 25 of 29 Amex comments are negative while 16 of 19 Delta comments are positive.
implication_text: The same location produces sharply different feedback patterns for Amex and Delta.

headline: JFK separates Capital One from Amex and Chase.
evidence_text: Capital One has 20 positive comments out of 24; Amex has 19 negative out of 31 and Chase has 16 negative out of 28.
implication_text: JFK shows a clear contrast: Capital One feedback is predominantly positive while Amex and Chase feedback is much more negative.

headline: LAS shows three distinctly different feedback mixes.
evidence_text: Capital One has 11 positive and no negative comments out of 12; Chase has 17 negative out of 30; Amex is nearly balanced at 8 positive and 7 negative out of 18.
implication_text: The three-way contrast shows that the same airport does not produce a uniform lounge feedback pattern across brands.

headline: LAX is the clearest Amex airport pressure point.
evidence_text: At LAX 25 of 29 Amex comments are negative while 16 of 19 Delta comments are positive.
implication_text: The concentration of negative Amex comments alongside positive Delta feedback makes LAX a distinctly local competitive pressure point.
evidence_threshold: Frozen watchlist and same-airport comparison eligibility

headline: SLC has Amex's most favorable comment mix among included airports.
evidence_text: Ten of 14 Amex comments at SLC are positive and one is negative.
implication_text: The result is directionally encouraging but remains outside the stricter positive-location ranking.

headline: DFW shows a focused capacity problem.
evidence_text: Thirteen of 23 Amex comments at DFW are negative; crowding is the strongest supported local driver across eight comments.
implication_text: The supported driver narrows DFW's negative pattern to a capacity-related experience issue.

headline: LAS is the clearest Chase airport pressure point.
evidence_text: At LAS 17 of 30 Chase comments are negative while 11 of 12 Capital One comments are positive.
implication_text: The same airport produces a much weaker feedback mix for Chase than for Capital One.

headline: LGA is the strongest positive Chase location in the measured feedback.
evidence_text: Seventeen of 28 Chase comments at LGA are positive and eight are negative.
implication_text: LGA is the clearest positive exception within Chase's measured airport feedback.

headline: JFK combines negative feedback with a clear queue-related issue.
evidence_text: Sixteen of 28 Chase comments at JFK are negative; wait time and queues are the strongest supported local driver across 11 comments.
implication_text: The supported queue driver suggests arrival and entry friction is central to Chase's negative JFK pattern.

headline: JFK is Capital One's strongest competitive location in the available feedback.
evidence_text: Twenty of 24 Capital One comments at JFK are positive while Amex and Chase feedback at the same airport leans negative.
implication_text: JFK shows a clear local contrast between Capital One's positive feedback mix and the more negative Amex and Chase patterns.

headline: LAS feedback is overwhelmingly positive for Capital One.
evidence_text: Eleven of 12 Capital One comments at LAS are positive and none are negative; Chase has 17 negative comments out of 30 at the same airport.
implication_text: The same-airport contrast makes Capital One's LAS feedback notably stronger than Chase's.

headline: DCA pairs positive feedback with a clear food-quality strength.
evidence_text: Ten of 16 Capital One comments at DCA are positive and one is negative; food quality is the strongest supported local driver across nine comments.
implication_text: Food quality appears to be a meaningful contributor to the positive Capital One feedback at DCA.
evidence_threshold: Frozen positive watchlist and supported-driver eligibility

headline: Delta feedback at LAX is predominantly positive.
evidence_text: Sixteen of 19 Delta comments at LAX are positive and one is negative.
implication_text: LAX is a strongly positive Delta result within the available 19-comment sample.

headline: LAX provides a clear head-to-head contrast with Amex.
evidence_text: Delta has 16 positive comments out of 19 at LAX while Amex has 25 negative comments out of 29.
implication_text: The same location produces opposite feedback patterns for Delta and Amex without implying a broader national result.
